Spaces planned around the people in them

Arsh Interior Solution is an interior studio near Crossing Sai Garden, Shaberi, Ghaziabad, run by Asmohammad, known to every client as Bhura Bhai. We take on offices first and homes alongside: kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms and flooring.

Our story

Our idea is simple: a room should look good and work well on the day it is handed over. From our base near Sai Garden crossing in Shaberi, Ghaziabad, we design and build interiors for offices and homes.

Offices are our main focus: workstations, director cabins, meeting rooms and reception areas. Alongside them we do modular kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms and flooring. Each plan is drawn for the actual room, with lighting, storage and finishing decided together.

Talk to the owner directly

Asmohammad, known as Bhura Bhai, leads Arsh Interior Solution. Call or message him with your space and what you need, and he will arrange a site visit.

How a project runs

1

Call or WhatsApp

Tell us your space, size and what you need.

2

Site visit

We see the space, measure it and note your ideas and budget.

3

Design and layout

Layout, ceiling, storage and lighting are planned together.

4

Choose materials

Pick woods, laminates, stone and colours that suit you.

5

Build and fit out

Carpentry, ceiling, flooring and finishing done on site.

6

Handover

A final walk-through so everything is right before you move in.
